question.text: A USDINR 82 call is priced at Rs. 1.20 when spot is 83.20. It is:

answer.text: In the Money with intrinsic value of Rs. 1.20; given premium of Rs. 1.20 implies zero time value
Cannot determine moneyness from given information

explanation.text: The Logic: Spot (83.20) is greater than strike (82), so the call is ITM. Intrinsic value = 83.20 - 82 = Rs. 1.20. Since the given premium equals the intrinsic value (Rs. 1.20), the implied time value is zero on the stated facts. The Trap: An unexpired option will generally have some time value, so the zero-time-value inference here follows from the given premium equaling intrinsic value, not from a general rule. Note: Moneyness terminology (ITM/ATM/OTM) and the intrinsic-value formula S - X for a call are supported by pages 69-71 of the NISM Series-I workbook.
